# Murray Cole

> > Technical blog and project portfolio covering LLM system design, AI agents, machine learning, data engineering, and cloud infrastructure.

Murray Cole shares practical guides and deep dives into building production AI systems, from LLM-powered applications to computer vision pipelines. The site features hands-on tutorials using technologies like Python, OpenAI APIs, TensorFlow, AWS, BigQuery, and Apache Spark, alongside security research and real-world project case studies.

## Key Topics

- Large Language Models (LLMs)
- GPT-3, GPT-4, Claude
- BERT and T5
- Python
- OpenAI API
- BigQuery
- AWS S3 Vectors
- Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN)
- Computer Vision
- LLM System Design
- Vector Databases
- Data Pipelines
- Model Training & Serving
- SQL & Data Quality
- Docker & Cloud Infrastructure

## Featured Projects

- [reelclips.tv](https://murraycole.com/projects/reelclips-tv): AI-powered Twitch/YouTube stream highlight generator using CNN
- [platen.ai - An AI writer that rivals or surpasses human capabilities](https://murraycole.com/projects/platen-ai): GPT-4 powered AI content writer with Next.js and AWS Batch

## LLM & AI Agent Development

- [LLM System Design: A Practical Guide](https://murraycole.com/posts/llm-system-design): Practical guide to building LLM systems with GPT-3, BERT, and T5
- [Build a Fast LLM Text-to-SQL Engine Without Frameworks](https://murraycole.com/posts/text-to-sql-engine): Build lightweight text-to-SQL engine with Claude/GPT-4o and SQLite
- [Claude 4 Opus Guide: Advanced AI Coding and Long-Running Tool Use](https://murraycole.com/posts/understanding-claude-4-opus): Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus for advanced coding and extended reasoning
- [Building an AI Agent's Code Execution Environment](https://murraycole.com/posts/ai-code-execution-environment): Sandboxed Python execution for AI agents with Jupyter Kernel Gateway
- [Building an LLM Evaluation Tool with Synthetic Data Generation in 20 mins](https://murraycole.com/posts/llm-evaluation-tool): Build LLM evaluation tool with Pydantic and synthetic data generation
- [How I Used an AI Agent's Memory to Achieve Remote Code Execution](https://murraycole.com/posts/how-i-used-an-ai-agents-memory-to-achieve-remote-code-execution): Exploiting eval() in Waclaude AI agent for RCE vulnerability

## Machine Learning & Computer Vision

- [Building Facial Recognition in Tensorflow](https://murraycole.com/posts/building-facial-recognition-in-tensorflow): Build facial recognition pipeline with TensorFlow, Dlib, and SVM
- [How to build an age and gender multi-task predictor with deep learning in TensorFlow](https://murraycole.com/posts/age-and-gender-predictor): Multi-task CNN for age and gender prediction using TensorFlow
- [Whisper Audio to Text: Transcribing Long Audio Files with Python](https://murraycole.com/posts/whisper-audio-to-text): Transcribe long audio with OpenAI Whisper using pydub chunking
- [AI Energy Consumption](https://murraycole.com/posts/ai-energy-consumption): Research on AI datacenter energy usage and global power demand

## Data Engineering & Cloud Infrastructure

- [AWS S3 Vectors Latency Analysis: Performance Benchmarks from 100 to 1M Vectors](https://murraycole.com/posts/aws-s3-vectors-latency-analysis): Benchmarking AWS S3 Vectors latency vs traditional vector databases
- [Spark Small Files Problem: Optimizing Data Processing](https://murraycole.com/posts/spark-small-files-problem): Solving Apache Spark small files problem in web crawling workflows
- [Building a CI/CD Pipeline for a Serverless Express Application with AWS CDK](https://murraycole.com/posts/building-ci-cd-pipeline-aws-cdk): Deploy serverless Express.js on AWS Lambda with CDK CI/CD pipeline

## SQL & Data Analysis

- [Exploring BigQuery Cohort Analysis](https://murraycole.com/posts/bigquery-content-analysis): User cohort analysis in BigQuery for retention and behavior analytics
- [SQL for Address Standardization: An Engineer's Approach](https://murraycole.com/posts/use-sql-for-address-standardization): SQL macros and REGEXP_REPLACE for cleaning messy addresses
- [Data Joins Explained: How to Merge Multiple Datasets Into One](https://murraycole.com/posts/joining-multiple-datasets): Master SQL and Python data join techniques for merging datasets
- [Understanding and Implementing Levenshtein Distance in BigQuery](https://murraycole.com/posts/levenshtein-distance-bigquery): Fuzzy string matching in BigQuery using EDIT_DISTANCE function
- [Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR): Definition, Calculation, and Applications](https://murraycole.com/posts/mean-reciprocal-rank): MRR metric for evaluating search engines and QA systems
